cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Distributor availability and one-for-one backing do not confer underlying-company shareholder rights or U.S. availability.

cells.text: Backed states the products are not registered or offered to U.S. persons. They are not the underlying issuer's common stock and do not demonstrate U.S. TSV eligibility, shareholder title or voting rights.
